primary_directive: Skip new design generation. REUSE original design from CashKlick repo.

typography.heading: Outfit
typography.rules: Maintain existing typography from the repo. Use fluid scaling.

colors.rules: Use the existing color palette defined in the CashKlick tailwind configuration. Maintain high contrast.

layout.spacing: Strictly follow the original repository's padding and margin scale.
layout.grid: Bento grids for dashboards, wide gap-8 for marketing. Ensure direct children in grid.

components.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

motion.rules: Maintain original transition effects. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: User explicitly requested to reuse the original design from the CashKlick repo. Do not overwrite core aesthetic choices unless fixing bugs or adding missing data-testid attributes. Ensure data-testid attributes are present on all key interactive elements.
